scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for(const p of ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']) fs.rmSync(p,{force:true}); if(!(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'').startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Use pnpm instead');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --filter @workspace/core --filter @workspace/render --filter @workspace/web --filter @workspace/storage --filter @workspace/local-gateway --filter @workspace/desktop run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --filter "./apps/**" --filter "./packages/**" --if-present run typecheck
